purpose: Behavior-certification fixtures for the agent-first AME learning redesign.
implementation_rule: Every certification must pass as a real API and browser scenario on the recommended clean local stack before the corresponding release is complete.
identity_rule: AME has one learner-owned resource model. An external agent, the AME web app, and another authorized client operate that model through the same unified API. There is no product-level agent account, agent scope, agent token, run door, or second resource API.
evidence_format: database assertions against the clean PostgreSQL baseline
happy, evil, and edge behavior-test results
expected versus observed outcome and final pass/fail decision

stories.name: agent_bootstraps_a_learner_journey
stories.persona: A learner asks an external agent for help.
stories.request: There is an AME platform. Use it to help me learn the topic I name.
agent_actions: create or resume the learner through the unified onboarding flow
preview a suitable versioned learning template
create the goal, journey, objectives, and first activity package
must_persist: one versioned learning goal and journey
observable objectives linked to skills or topics
an explanation, worked example, diagnostic/practice activity, and next action
must_not_persist: an agent account or agent-owned copy of the learner
duplicate learner, journey, or starter activities on retry
learning progress before an activity is actually completed
certification: The external agent can complete the bootstrap without a manually designed curriculum.
The browser can open the same journey and resume it after refresh.
The same idempotency identity returns the existing bootstrap result.
The learner can see what they will learn, why the first activity exists, and what comes next.

stories.name: agent_composes_a_grounded_assessment
stories.persona: An agent turns the learner's objective into assessable work.

input.objective: Explain one observable concept from the learner-selected topic

agent_actions: link each question to an objective or skill
include explanation, answer rationale, source/provenance, and difficulty metadata
compose an ordered assessment from those questions
must_support: multiple choice with stable answer identity despite presentation shuffling
essay or code response that can remain pending manual or agent review
question and assessment versioning without rewriting historical attempts
certification: The learner sees a readable assessment rather than raw generated JSON.
Every item is traceable to an objective and content provenance.
Editing a current question creates a new version and leaves old attempts reproducible.
An untrusted or incomplete generated item cannot be presented as approved learning content.

stories.name: learner_completes_practice_and_exam_with_results
stories.persona: The learner practices, then takes a meaningful exam.

input.practice_answers: mixed correct and incorrect answers across two objectives

must_support: durable activity session and attempt state
server-side scoring for objectively gradable items
explicit pending-review state for essay or code items
certification: Shuffled multiple-choice options still grade and display the correct answer correctly.
A learner can resume an interrupted attempt without losing answers or creating a second attempt.
Results explain weak objectives using actual evidence, not a hardcoded topic rule.
The recommended activity starts without rebuilding the journey.
Practice results do not masquerade as a passed exam.

stories.name: agent_deepens_a_weak_topic
stories.persona: The learner asks the agent to explain the topic exposed by evidence.

input.weak_objective: Understand reconciliation, savepoints, and upgrade behavior
input.request: Explain this deeply with a minimal example and tell me what to try next.

agent_actions: create or retrieve a grounded deep-dive linked to the weak objective
include explanation, example, caveats, source references, and a small application task
offer the deep-dive as the next learner activity
certification: The deep-dive is linked to the actual weak objective and triggering evidence.
The learner can read it in the same journey and complete its application task.
Content provenance and review status are visible to the system and appropriate to the learner.
A generated explanation never silently changes mastery or exam status.

stories.name: progress_survives_sessions_and_clients
stories.persona: The learner returns later, possibly through a different agent or the browser.
must_persist: streak state with explicit timezone and qualifying-event rules
certification: The browser and an authorized external agent observe the same learner state.
A restart does not erase progress or duplicate completed activities.
A qualifying learning event updates the streak exactly once.
A failed or abandoned activity does not falsely advance mastery.
A second client can continue the learner's journey without creating a second identity.

stories.name: self_host_operator_runs_one_coherent_origin
stories.persona: A self-host operator validates the product before inviting learners.
certification: The documented Postgres + Valkey + API + web + Caddy stack reaches its declared state from a clean volume.
Human docs and machine contracts agree with the same public origin.
Registration and C1 work without SMTP.
API or web restart preserves the learner journey and progress.
No system-level Caddy or undocumented alternate origin is required by the recommended stack.

happy: new learner bootstrap is idempotent and produces a visible first learning moment
versioned questions compose into practice and graded assessments
objective evidence produces understandable results and one next action
a linked deep-dive becomes a readable, actionable activity
progress, streak, and recommendations survive restart and client changes
the five-service local stack serves one coherent public origin
evil: replay onboarding with the same idempotency identity
attempt to read or mutate another learner's journey, question, attempt, or deep-dive
submit an answer using a stale question or assessment version
forge a score, mastery update, streak event, or recommendation
present unreviewed generated content as approved or passed learning
continue a session after expiry or logout
claim an existing email account without the configured claim path
make a provider or Valkey dependency fail during bootstrap or completion
edge: bootstrap fails after each durable write and then retries
the learner abandons and resumes an in-progress attempt
an assessment contains no objectively gradable items
an assessment mixes objective, short-answer, essay, and code items
the same answer is submitted twice
a question is revised after an old attempt is complete
the learner has no evidence yet, or has tied objective scores
the local calendar day and configured learner timezone change at a streak boundary
the public document is requested directly and through Caddy

release_rule: C1-C6 remain pending until their API, database, browser, and behavior-test evidence is attached. A passing unit test or mock agent alone is not certification.
